titulo: Your TV remote never points at the soundbar

frases.texto: Your TV remote can turn the soundbar up, and you never pointed at it.
That light stops at the TV. The soundbar never sees it.
The order walks down the HDMI cable, on one single wire.
The TV says louder, and it shuts its own speakers.
One press can put every box on that wire to sleep.

frases.dicho: Samsung calls that wire Anynet plus.

frases.texto: Sony calls it Bravia Sync, and LG calls it SimpLink.
Same wire. So one remote can run the whole pile.
Now your phone can be that remote.
The app is in the link in bio.
Send it to that friend who still keeps three remotes on the couch.
